comments.author: JRandomHacker42
comments.why: Parallels between school architecture and shooter maps
comments.text: Jacob Geller did a really interesting video essay [1] about the parallels that can be drawn between modern school architecture and maps from shooter games - on top of whatever other context or functionality they provide, they are fundamentally spaces that are designed around the question "what happens if violence occurs here?"
